subject.title: fix(agents): prevent transcript redaction from corrupting signed reasoning

question: Should the unlinked live run IDs in this PR count as sufficient real-behavior proof, or must redacted artifacts or logs be attached before merge?
rationale: The code and CI are convincing, but only maintainers can determine whether the named internal runs are accessible and trustworthy enough to satisfy the external-PR proof gate without visible artifacts.

options.title: Require inspectable proof
options.body: Ask for redacted logs or artifact manifests showing exact Bedrock replay and simultaneous user-secret redaction before merging.

options.title: Accept internal run records
options.body: Treat the named run IDs as sufficient only if a maintainer can inspect and verify their retained artifacts internally.

recommendation.title: Require inspectable proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted logs or artifact manifests showing exact Bedrock replay and simultaneous user-secret redaction before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current signed-replay preservation contract and are the strongest history-based owner for validating its proof boundary.
